purpose: Transparent illustration cutouts for Rasikh cards
prompt: Preserve the existing characters, poses, clothing, colors, texture and story. Remove the empty beige backdrop and exterior rectangular sky, wall and floor. Keep the principal figures, foliage and architecture inside a deliberate irregular silhouette, with a curved ground platform. Use genuinely transparent alpha outside the cutout. No colored rectangle, checkerboard, border, glow or blurry fade.
company_edge_cleanup_prompt: Remove the colored halo outside the people, plants, arch and round platforms. Keep the interior artwork unchanged and use a crisp anti-aliased transparent boundary.
company_presentation_note: The generated company asset retained a halo; a proportional SVG silhouette mask in the shared Illustration component removes it in the rendered card.
